name: rs-nest
description: rusts — a TypeScript-flavored language that transpiles to plain Rust, plus nestrs, a NestJS-style app written in it

scripts.dev: npm run build:ts && cargo run --manifest-path nestrs/Cargo.toml
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && cargo build --manifest-path nestrs/Cargo.toml
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run examples && npm run build
